one_line: Sultan Alauddin Khalji and Rana Ratnasimha face each other across the 1303 siege of Chittor, where Khalji expansion first broke through the Rajput stronghold in Rajasthan.

appearance.age_look: Both appear in their late 30s to early 40s, athletic and battle-hardened, with broad shoulders and strong builds suited to war leaders.
appearance.face: Alauddin has an oval face, wheatish-olive complexion, neatly trimmed pointed black beard and moustache, sharp dark eyes with a calculating gaze and a calm, authoritative default expression; Ratnasimha has a slightly squarer face, sun-browned medium complexion, high cheekbones, a strong jaw with a thick but groomed moustache and short beard, large intense eyes and a proud, resolute default expression.
appearance.hair: Alauddin’s black hair is shoulder-length, smooth and mostly hidden under a dark green quilted war-turban (kulah) wrapped over a conical steel helmet with a small nasal bar and a short mail aventail at the sides; Ratnasimha’s dark brown hair is tied back in a short knot at the back of the head, partly covered by a saffron-ochre Rajput cloth turban (pagri) with a slim upright feather plume and a small central gold brooch.
appearance.costume: Alauddin wears a dark green, long-sleeved quilted coat (alkan) reaching mid-calf over a mail hauberk, both belted at the waist with a brown leather belt holding a dagger; his trousers are narrow white cotton churidars tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots, and over the mail he has a sleeveless, steel-plated lamellar cuirass with simple rivets, plus plain steel bracers, all with minimal decoration befitting a campaign; Ratnasimha wears a knee-length saffron-ochre cotton angarkha tied to the side over mail, with a deep maroon wool patka sash around the waist, a fitted steel breastplate shaped to the torso over the angarkha, cream-coloured tight trousers and dark brown leather boots, and simple gold stud earrings and a thin gold armlet visible on one upper arm, suggesting Rajput royal status without excessive ornamentation.
appearance.signature: Alauddin carries a slightly curved Indo-Turkish steel sword (shamshir) with a simple cross-guard, brown leather-wrapped hilt and plain steel scabbard slung at his left hip, while Ratnasimha holds a broad-bladed Rajput talwar with a disc pommel, slightly flared tip and a plain steel shield (dhal) with four raised bosses strapped to his left forearm.

ref_desc: Alauddin Khalji and Ratnasimha stand side by side, Alauddin in dark green quilted coat over mail and lamellar, war-turbaned helmet and shamshir, Ratnasimha in saffron-ochre angarkha over mail and breastplate, Rajput turban, talwar and shield, in green, saffron, maroon, cream and steel grey tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two opposing leaders from the 1303 siege of Chittor: on one side Alauddin Khalji, with an oval wheatish-olive face, pointed black beard and sharp dark eyes, wearing a conical steel helmet wrapped in a dark green quilted war-turban with a small nasal bar and short mail at the sides; his shoulder-length black hair is mostly hidden. His costume is a dark green long-sleeved quilted coat reaching mid-calf over a visible mail hauberk, belted with a brown leather belt holding a dagger, narrow white churidar trousers and mid-calf brown leather boots, plus a sleeveless steel-plated lamellar cuirass and plain steel bracers that read as practical campaign armour; at his left hip hangs a slightly curved shamshir with simple cross-guard, brown leather-wrapped hilt and plain steel scabbard. On the other side Ratnasimha has a slightly squarer, sun-browned face, high cheekbones, intense eyes and a thick groomed moustache with a short beard, his dark brown hair tied back in a short knot; he wears a saffron-ochre cloth Rajput pagri with a slim upright feather plume and a small central gold brooch. His outfit is a knee-length saffron-ochre cotton angarkha over mail, tied to the side, cinched with a deep maroon wool patka sash, a fitted steel breastplate over the chest, cream-coloured tight trousers, and dark brown leather boots, with subtle gold stud earrings and a thin gold armlet on one upper arm. He grips a broad-bladed Rajput talwar with disc pommel in his right hand and has a plain steel shield with four raised bosses strapped to his left forearm. Show them in a neutral stance, side by side but angled slightly apart, clearly displaying their distinct helmets, turbans, armour, belts, boots and weapons, in a restrained palette of dark green, saffron-ochre, maroon, cream and steel grey, with clean linework and consistent anime proportions suitable for reuse across action panels.
